nodes.description: ProvablyRareGem.gems mapping(uint=>Gem) storing entropy, difficulty, multiplier, gemsPerMine, crafter and manager per gem kind.
ProvablyRareGem.nonce mapping(address=>uint) incremented on every mine; part of the luck preimage.
ProvablyRareGem.gemCount counter of registered gem kinds, also used as bound for kind checks.
ERC1155 balance mapping(uint256=>mapping(address=>uint256)) updated on mint/transfer/burn.
ERC1155Supply per-kind total supply mapping, used by LOOTGemCrafter.craft cap.
Immutable IERC721 NFT contract used for ownership checks in _claim.
Immutable ProvablyRareGem contract invoked by start/craft/_claim.
Immutable first gem kind created by the LOOT gem crafter constructor.
Public randomness seed taken from blockhash(block.number-1) in start(), consumed by airdrop.
mapping(uint=>uint) tracking how many gems were crafted per kind, checked against 10% of supply.
mapping(uint=>bool) one-time claim flag per NFT id.
Ownable owner address controlling onlyOwner functions.
External function validating difficulty, gemsPerMine, multiplier and manager before calling _create.
nonReentrant mining entry point: computes luck, bumps nonce, increases difficulty, mints gems to msg.sender.
View helper hashing block.chainid, entropy, address(this), msg.sender, kind, nonce and salt.
Internal gem kind creation: increments gemCount, writes the Gem struct and emits Create.
Sets gem entropy; guarded by manager or crafter identity check.
Sets gem name and color; guarded by gem manager identity check.
Sets difficulty, multiplier and gemsPerMine; guarded by gem manager identity check.
nonReentrant crafter-only mint of gemsPerMine or explicit amount to a chosen address.
Builds the on-chain SVG/JSON metadata for a gem kind via Base64.
Internal ERC1155 mint updating balances and performing receiver acceptance check.
Internal single transfer updating balances inside unchecked subtraction then acceptance check.
Calls onERC1155Received on contract recipients, enabling recipient-controlled callbacks.
Internal burn decrementing balance with unchecked subtraction.
onlyOwner one-time start: derives hashseed from blockhash and pushes entropy into gem kinds.
nonReentrant onlyOwner gem minting capped at 10% of total supply per kind.
View computing the deterministic welcome pack for an NFT id from hashseed.
nonReentrant external claim for a single NFT id.
nonReentrant external claim looping over several NFT ids.
Internal claim: owner check, claimed flag, airdrop computation and repeated external GEM.craft calls.
Modifier enforcing owner()==_msgSender() for privileged functions.
Modifier that sets _status to _ENTERED around the call to block nested external calls.
Transfers pending management to msg.sender after checking pendingManager.
Clears manager and pendingManager for given kinds, only by current manager.
Sets the crafter address for given kinds, only by current manager.
Sets pendingManager for given kinds, only by current manager.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, nonce accounting and mint recipients.
External call from LOOTGemCrafter into ProvablyRareGem.craft during claim/craft flows.
External call to the NFT contract ownerOf used as the only gate for claim eligibility.
Recipient-controlled ERC1155 receiver callback invoked after balance updates.
difficulty = (diff * multiplier) / 10000 + 1 computation in mine; relies on the earlier overflow require.
crafted[kind] += amount followed by a 10% supply cap comparison in LOOTGemCrafter.craft.
Unchecked balance subtractions in ERC1155 transfer and burn routines.
hashseed = blockhash(block.number - 1) used as the airdrop randomness source.
Gem name argument of ProvablyRareGem.create.
Gem color argument of ProvablyRareGem.create.
Initial mining difficulty bounded to (0, 2**128] in create.
Gems minted per successful mine, bounded to (0, 1e6].
Difficulty multiplier times 1e4, bounded to [1e4, 1e10].
Address allowed to craft gems of the new kind.
Address allowed to administer the new gem kind; must be non-zero.
Gem kind to mine, bounded by gemCount.
Miner-chosen salt fed into luck().
Gem kind whose entropy is updated.
New bytes32 entropy value for the gem kind.
Array of gem kinds whose pending management is accepted.
Gem kind minted by ProvablyRareGem.craft.
Explicit amount minted (0 means gemsPerMine).
Recipient of crafter-minted gems.
Gem kind whose metadata URI is built.
Gem kind crafted by the LOOT owner.
Craft amount booked into crafted[kind] and passed to GEM.craft.
NFT id for which the deterministic airdrop is computed.
NFT id claimed by the caller.
Array of NFT ids claimed in one transaction.
NFT id validated, marked claimed and used for the airdrop.
Luck value computed by luck(kind, salt) inside mine.
Cached difficulty of gems[kind] inside mine.
Cached gems[kind].entropy read inside luck.
abi.encodePacked preimage hashed with keccak256 in luck.
uint[4] resulting airdrop gem kinds.
Number of gems already chosen in the airdrop loop.
keccak256(hashseed, offset, id) pseudo-random seed used for rare rolls.
Airdrop result array iterated over when calling GEM.craft.
New gem kind index assigned from gemCount++ inside _create.

edges.reason: create.name is stored into the Gem struct built by create/_create.
create.color is stored into the Gem struct.
create.difficulty is validated and stored as the initial difficulty.
create.gemsPerMine is bounded and stored for the new gem kind.
create.multiplier is bounded and stored for the new gem kind.
create.crafter becomes the gem crafter.
create.manager becomes the gem manager after the non-zero check.
create delegates all state writes to the internal _create helper.
mine.kind is forwarded into luck().
mine.salt is forwarded into luck().
mine calls the luck view function to obtain the mining value.
msg.sender increments nonce and is the mint recipient in mine.
local val gates the mine success require.
local diff feeds both the overflow require and the new difficulty.
mine reads gems[kind] difficulty, multiplier and gemsPerMine.
mine increments nonce[msg.sender] before minting.
mine computes (diff * multiplier) / 10000 + 1 which can overflow if the guard is bypassed.
gems[kind].multiplier and difficulty feed the difficulty update arithmetic.
The computed difficulty is written back into gems[kind].difficulty.
luck reads the cached entropy before hashing.
luck hashes the packed preimage into the returned uint.
luck reads gems[kind].entropy.
luck mixes nonce[msg.sender] into the preimage.
_create consumes gemCount as the new kind and increments it.
local kind is the index used to write the new Gem struct.
_create writes the new Gem struct into gems[kind].
_create increments gemCount.
updateEntropy.kind selects the gem entry to modify.
updateEntropy.entropy is the new entropy written to state.
msg.sender must equal gems[kind].manager or crafter to update entropy.
updateEntropy writes gems[kind].entropy.
msg.sender must equal gems[kind].manager to change metadata.
updateGemInfo writes gems[kind].name and color.
msg.sender must equal gems[kind].manager to change mining data.
updateMiningData writes difficulty, multiplier and gemsPerMine.
acceptManager iterates over the supplied kinds array.
msg.sender must equal pendingManager to take over a gem kind.
acceptManager sets gems[kind].manager and clears pendingManager.
msg.sender must be the gem manager to renounce it.
renounceManager clears manager and pendingManager fields.
msg.sender must be the gem manager to change the crafter.
updateCrafter writes gems[kind].crafter.
msg.sender must be the gem manager to nominate a pending manager.
transferManager writes gems[kind].pendingManager.
craft.kind selects the gem kind to mint.
craft.amount is used when non-zero, otherwise gemsPerMine is used.
craft.to receives the minted gems.
msg.sender must equal gems[kind].crafter to mint.
craft mints through the internal ERC1155 _mint routine.
_mint triggers the receiver acceptance check that can call back into the caller.
Acceptance check performs an external onERC1155Received call to a contract recipient.
_safeTransferFrom performs the acceptance check after balance updates.
_safeTransferFrom subtracts the amount inside an unchecked block.
_burn subtracts the amount inside an unchecked block.
uri.kind selects the gem whose metadata is rendered.
start derives hashseed from a past block hash, a miner-influenceable randomness source.
The blockhash result is stored into the public hashseed state variable.
start requires hashseed to be zero to guarantee single initialization.
start is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
onlyOwner modifier gates start.
onlyOwner compares the stored _owner with _msgSender().
LOOT craft.kind indexes crafted and is forwarded to GEM.craft.
LOOT craft.amount is added to crafted and forwarded to GEM.craft.
LOOT craft is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner and receives the minted gems.
onlyOwner modifier gates LOOTGemCrafter.craft.
crafted[kind] += amount followed by the 10% supply cap check can overflow.
The crafted mapping supplies the operand of the accumulation.
craft compares the running crafted total against the supply cap.
LOOTGemCrafter.craft performs an external call to GEM.craft.
The immutable GEM reference is the target of the external craft call.
The external call re-enters the gem contract craft function.
_claim performs external GEM.craft calls while recipient code can run during minting.
airdrop.id feeds the deterministic seed computation.
The kinds array is progressively filled by the airdrop loop.
count bounds the number of gems written in the airdrop loop.
The derived seed determines which rare gem kinds are granted.
airdrop is fully determined by the public hashseed, making rare outcomes predictable.
_claim calls airdrop to determine which gems to mint.
claim.id is passed to the internal _claim routine.
claim delegates to _claim.
multiClaim iterates over the supplied ids.
multiClaim calls _claim once per id.
_claim.id is checked, marked claimed and used for the airdrop.
_claim requires msg.sender to be the NFT owner of the id.
The immutable NFT contract is the target of the ownerOf call.
_claim performs the external ownerOf query.
The result of ownerOf is the sole authorization gate for claiming.
_claim reads claimed[id] to reject double claims.
_claim sets claimed[id] to true before minting.
The airdrop result array is iterated when calling GEM.craft.
nonReentrant guard wraps the mine entry point.
nonReentrant guard wraps the gem craft entry point.
nonReentrant guard wraps LOOTGemCrafter.craft.
nonReentrant guard wraps claim.
nonReentrant guard wraps multiClaim.
ERC1155Supply override updates total supply after each mint.
_safeTransferFrom reads and writes the balance mapping.
_mint increases the recipient balance in the balance mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Name is only consumed by create and its internal helper; folding it into the create function node keeps the graph compact.
Color is only consumed by create/_create.
Difficulty is a transient validation input for the create flow.
GemsPerMine is only used to initialize the new gem kind in create.
Multiplier is only used to initialize the new gem kind in create.
Crafter is stored by create and has no independent behaviour.
Manager is stored by create and has no independent behaviour.
Kind is a local selector inside mine, forwarded to luck and gems.
Salt only influences the luck computation inside mine.
Val is a temporary luck result used only for the mine require.
Diff is a cached difficulty value scoped to mine.
Entropy is a short-lived cache inside the luck view function.
The packed preimage is a temporary buffer local to luck.
Kind is the temporary index used to build the Gem struct in _create.
Kind is only used to index gems inside updateEntropy.
Entropy is the value written by updateEntropy.
Kinds is a loop input within acceptManager.
Kind selects the gem entry inside craft.
Amount is a transient override of gemsPerMine inside craft.
To is the mint recipient passed directly into _mint by craft.
Kind only selects the gem metadata rendered by uri.
Kind indexes crafted and is forwarded to GEM.craft inside LOOT craft.
Amount is accumulated in crafted and forwarded to GEM.craft.
Id only seeds the deterministic airdrop computation.
Id is passed straight through to _claim.
Ids is the loop input of multiClaim.
Id is validated and marked claimed inside _claim.
The kinds array is the return buffer assembled inside airdrop.
Count tracks loop progress inside airdrop only.
Seed is a per-iteration temporary used to test rarity.
Kinds holds the airdrop result iterated by _claim when calling GEM.craft.
